title: When the Verdict Falls
author: V. M. Nystrom
blurb: Sebastian Brightwater, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
